svg.title: One tracker cycle and its ellipse gate
svg.desc: A track cycle predicts, associates by a squared Mahalanobis gate and one-to-one Hungarian assignment, updates with the Joseph-form covariance, initiates tentative tracks from unmatched measurements, and manages the lifecycle. The gate is an ellipse: a measurement close in metres can lie outside it. The threshold 11.345 is the 99 percent quantile of chi-square with 3 degrees of freedom.
